title: Optimize Lite - Launch Kit, PRD and Roadmap
author: Sofia Martinez
body:
Overview:

This document consolidates the product brief, minimal viable PRD, light design constraints, phased roadmap, pricing guidance, and the initial release notes for a compact optimization add-on named "Optimize Lite". Optimize Lite targets small engineering teams and early-stage customers who want measurable inference cost savings with minimal operations overhead.

Purpose:
- Single source of truth to align product, engineering, solutions, and GTM for the first release.
- Keep scope small and safe: automated, explainable suggestions; conservative canaries and shadowing; billing tied to auto-apply usage.

Audience:
- Product managers, engineering leads (Optimize & Runtime), Applied ML, SEs, Sales, Customer Success.

Executive summary (one paragraph):
Optimize Lite provides per-tenant, per-route optimization suggestions (batching, prefix caching, curated quant profiles) surfaced in the Redwood Console and via a small Suggestions API. Customers can evaluate suggestions in shadow mode, then opt to canary and auto-apply changes. The goal is a low-friction cost-reduction product with built-in safety and clear commercial packaging.

Top-level goals (measurable):
1) Deliver three suggestion classes with console and API access within GA.
2) Demonstrate >=22% token-cost reduction for transactional benchmarks during pilot.
3) Ensure auto-applies do not increase 99p latency by >5% (automated rollback).
4) Convert 40% of beta customers to paid within 90 days of GA.

Out-of-scope:
- Full Optimize Conductor orchestration (no multi-model switching).
- Automated private/on-prem packaging in v1 (Phase 2 adds manual import/export).

MVE feature list:
- Console: per-route "Optimization Suggestions" panel showing ranked recommendations, estimated savings, risk level, and actions: "Evaluate (shadow)", "Apply (canary)", "Rollback".
- API: suggestions retrieval and apply endpoints (tenant-scoped).
- Suggestion types: batching (adjust batch window and thresholds), prefix/KV caching recommendations, curated quantization profiles (validated list).
- Safety: shadow evaluation, staged canaries, automated rollback triggers, audit trail.

High-level PRD (requirements):
- RQ-01 Suggestion API:
  - Tenant and route scoping required.
  - Response fields: suggestion_id, tenant_id, route, type, friendly_description, estimated_tokens_saved_per_1M, estimated_latency_delta_ms, confidence_score, risk_level.
- RQ-02 Console UX:
  - Suggestions appear on route page. Each suggestion shows an explanation, expected savings, and confidence. Buttons: "Shadow Evaluate", "Canary Apply" (with canary size/duration UI), "Rollback".
- RQ-03 Safety and SLOs:
  - Canary default: 1% traffic for 30m. Monitors: shadow-evaluator delta (default threshold 2%), 99p latency (>5% trigger), error rate increase (>0.5% absolute). On trigger, auto-rollback within 5 minutes and page owner.
- RQ-04 Billing & Quotas:
  - Track suggestions evaluated and suggestions auto-applied. Billing meter charged only for auto-applies and a low monthly add-on fee.
- RQ-05 Metrics & observability:
  - Emit metrics for suggestions_generated, suggestions_evaluated, suggestions_applied, canary_regressions, estimated_tokens_saved. Console shows time-series for these per-tenant.

Design notes and constraints:
- Reuse telemetry ingestion and sampling components from Optimize Conductor where feasible to reduce implementation scope.
- Suggestion ranking uses deterministic heuristics plus an offline-trained lightweight ranker updated weekly; no heavy online retrain in v1.
- All apply operations must be idempotent and accept a dry_run flag.
- Applies translate to runtime policy updates via an internal runtime policy API; the runtime owner must provide a backwards-compatible apply contract.

Data flow (textual):
1) Sampling agent collects request metadata -> profiler constructs distributions (seq_len, latency, prefix entropy).
2) Suggestion engine (rules + ranker) writes candidate suggestions to suggestions-store.
3) Console/API reads store; user triggers shadow/canary workflows which call evaluation service and runtime policy apply API.

Runtime apply contract (summary):
- Endpoint: POST /internal/runtime/policy/apply
- Required fields: tenant_id, route, apply_token, suggestion_id, dry_run (bool).
- Must respond with apply_id, status, and be idempotent for the same apply_token.

Example Suggestion (JSON as text for docs):
{
  "suggestion_id": "sug-20260601-042",
  "tenant_id": "t-01xWz",
  "route": "/v1/chat/completions",
  "type": "prefix_cache",
  "friendly_description": "Enable prefix cache for common 1-3 token prefixes and TTL 30s for requests with seq_len <= 128.",
  "estimated_tokens_saved_per_1M": "18,400",
  "estimated_latency_delta_ms": "-0.5",
  "confidence_score": "0.78",
  "risk_level": "low"
}

CLI example (apply canary):
redwood optimize-lite apply --tenant t-01xWz --suggestion sug-20260601-042 --canary-pct 1 --duration 30m --dry-run=false

Safety, monitoring, and alerts:
- Primary automated triggers for rollback: shadow loss delta > 2%, 99p latency increase >5%, error-rate delta >0.5% absolute.
- Alerts to create: P0 when any canary triggers; P1 when an apply occurs with no audit entry.
- Required dashboards: per-tenant suggestion health, canary outcomes, cumulative estimated tokens saved.

Acceptance criteria for GA:
- Suggestions API P95 latency < 200ms under expected load.
- E2E pilot shows >=20% token-cost reduction on target transactional benchmark with no >5% 99p latency regression during canary.
- Security review completed for suggestion-store access and apply workflow (KMS/SSO integration validated).

Roadmap and rollout plan (phased):
- Phase Alpha (4 weeks): internal pilot with 3 internal tenants. Deliver profiler, suggestion engine, suggestions-store, basic console view (read-only).
- Phase Beta (6 weeks): public beta for hosted tenants. Shadow-evaluation enabled; onboarding templates for SEs. Target: 25 external beta customers.
- Phase GA (6-8 weeks): enable canary auto-apply and billing integration. Launch Starter and Scale SKUs.
- Phase Dedicated Support (Q3 post-GA): add manual import/export of suggestion policies for Dedicated and on-prem customers; plan for automated on-prem runner in a future release.

Pricing & packaging guidance (proposal):
- Pricing objectives: low entry cost, transparent ROI, predictable unit billing.
- Proposed SKUs:
  - Free (shadow-only): 0-3 evaluations/month per tenant.
  - Starter: $99/month + 0.2% of monthly inference spend; up to 50 evaluations and 100 auto-applies/month.
  - Scale: $799/month + 0.1% of monthly inference spend; higher quotas and SLA options.
  - Enterprise: negotiated with Dedicated support and professional services for policy transfer.
- Billing meters to implement: suggestions_evaluated (count), suggestions_autopplied (count), estimated_tokens_saved (tokens).

GTM / Sales enablement notes:
- Core pitch: "Reduce inference spend safely with explainable, one-click optimizations".
- Key objections & suggested responses:
  1) "We fear quality regressions" -> emphasize shadow-eval, small canaries, automatic rollback, and SE review.
  2) "We already tune batching in-house" -> highlight easy operationalization, continuous suggestions as traffic patterns change, and quantization recommendations validated by Applied ML.
  3) "How are we billed?" -> clear quota-based monthly subscriptions plus per-auto-apply meter; free shadow-only tier.

SE onboarding checklist (for first deploy):
1) Capture 48-72 hours of representative traffic via profiler.
2) Produce and review first suggestion set with customer; agree risk appetite and observability signals.
3) Enable shadow evaluation for 72 hours and inspect loss and latency deltas.
4) If acceptable, enable canary apply at 1% for 30 minutes and review results.

Support & incident playbook (short):
- If canary triggers rollback automatically, notify customer and SE owner; create incident and collect request/response traces and shadow evaluation artifacts.
- If auto-rollback fails, manual rollback CLI: redwood optimize-lite rollback --tenant <id> --apply_id <id>.
- Escalation: Applied ML for quality investigations; Runtime oncall for performance/latency regressions.

GA Release Notes (v1.0) Summary:
- Release date: 2026-05-10
- Status: GA (hosted)
